name: The Improvement Company map
note: Doc 23. Acquired at A4 -- doc 04's FAN_A1, where there is no way to withhold the deed number and the map comes anyway with Claim Two already circled. Doc 23 note 3: the second LOOK is the Fanshawe rule stated by a man who does not yet know it is one.

LOOK_AT.say: A printed map of the district, given to me free by the Improvement Company. Claim Two is circled.
repeat: I did not circle it. I have thought about that several times since.
The roads on it are accurate. Everything else on it is an advertisement.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper. Good paper — better than the deed it describes.
